item.title: Catch Seven White Sox Home Games on The U
item.description: Chicago Sports Network (CHSN) and The U are taking viewers out to the ball game with the addition of seven regular season Chicago White Sox games. The first series of games features the classic rivalry as the White Sox take on the Chicago Cubs in the Crosstown Series, Friday, July 25 - Sunday, July 27 on The U.

item.title: Sky Unguarded Returns with Sky Unguarded: 20 Years in the Making
item.description: The U's locally produced Sky-centered half-hour special, Sky Unguarded, concludes this week with the final episode, Sky Unguarded: 20 Years in the Making. Get a look at the Sky in the early years, a deep dive into the rise of the championship season in 2021, and more.

item.title: New Fall Schedule on The U: Premieres and Schedule Changes
item.description: Monday, September 8, the first of our fall schedule changes took effect, introducing new shows and programming changes. These changes will continue with more premieres coming up Monday, September 22. Check out what's coming and when you can watch all your favorite shows on The U.

item.title: White Sox Dog Day: Baseball's Best Four-Legged Fans
item.description: Monday, September 15, The U had the pleasure of meeting the ulti-mutt Sox fans at the White Sox's biannual Dog Day at Guaranteed Rate Field. Check out clips and pictures from the event!

item.title: Inside the Booth: Q&A with Dave Bernhard on the IHSA Football State Finals
item.description: Get an inside look at the IHSA State Finals Class 1A-8A Championship games with an exclusive Q&A with Play-by-Play announcer Dave Bernhard.

item.title: Winter Weather Postpones High School Championships
item.description: Due to the winter storm warning issued by the National Weather Service for Central Illinois, the IHSA 5A-8A State Championships have been postponed.

item.title: Fill a Bag, Fill a Bus 2025 Recap: Thank you, Chicago
item.description: Thursday, December 11, in Oak Lawn and Friday, December 12, in River Forest, The U, MeTV FM, and our incredible partners - the Greater Chicago Food Depository, Jewel-Osco, CTA, Walner Law and AlmostFreeTeeth.com - joined forces for our annual 'Fill a Bag, Fill a Bus' food drive. Thank you to all who donated both in person and online! Check out exclusive photos from the event.

item.title: Basketball is Back: Watch 30 Boys and Girls High School Games on The U and The U Too
item.description: This winter sports season, The U, Chicago's home for local high school sports, is ramping up the excitement with an action-packed schedule featuring 30 boys' and girls' basketball games including the IHSA Girls and Boys State Finals.

item.title: Watch Seinfeld Weeknights on The U for your Chance to Win Tickets to See Jerry Seinfeld
item.description: Monday, February 2, through Friday, February 20, watch Seinfeld weeknights at 10pm & 10:30pm on The U for your chance to win a trip for 2 to Las Vegas to see Jerry Seinfeld at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace, complete with air travel and two nights at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas. Courtesy of Windy City Travel, the Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority, and the Fontainebleau Las Vegas.
